capabilities: View CSV files in a table with numbered rows and columns
Edit cells and add, delete, or move rows and columns via right-click
Search the file and pin the selected column for visibility
Toggle between table view, raw source mode, and first-row-as-header
Auto-detect delimiters and re-parse without rewriting the file
extras: README includes troubleshooting guidance with a downloadable test-sample.csv and notes that per-file metadata is stored as JSON under .obsidian/plugins/csv rather than data.json; the author mentions possibly building a json/csv-based database plugin in the future.
motivation: The author felt existing CSV plugins were too complex and wanted a simple, straightforward tool that keeps up with the latest Obsidian API.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit CSV files natively, forcing users to switch to another application to view or modify tabular data in their vault.
summary: Minimal CSV viewer and editor that opens .csv files in a workspace table view with cell editing, search, delimiter auto-detection, and source mode.
